posts.title: Working for a living
posts.description: As Día de Muertos approaches and skulls and skeletons seem to be materializing around every corner, I want to highlight the mural painted in October 2025 by Cheni Velazco Santibañez. posts.title: Time for the green, white, and red
posts.description: August hadn’t even come to a close when the green, white, and red colors of the Mexican flag began appearing in shops, streets, and restaurants. Why? posts.title: Scenes from around town
posts.description: From the sublime to the ridiculous and from the mundane to the special, scenes around Oaxaca frequently bring a smile. I miss this when I’m not here.
